name: caisse_v1_final_readiness_waves
episode_body: Caisse V1 final readiness waves executed locally on 2026-04-26. Verdict: HOLD for release, PASS_WITH_SCOPED_REWORK for local code proof. Critical PHP targeted suites passed: payment/revenue 12, quote 11, KDS 9, fiscal 8, branch/symmetry 8, ops/outbox/rollout/observability 17, payment/web/Stripe/offline red-team 9, migration tooling 5, enum rework regression 3. Vitest targeted suite passed: 4 files / 11 tests. Playwright source-level suite passed: 2 tests. Static guards passed after fixing app/Http/Requests/OrderStatusRequest.php to use OrderStatus::CANCELED instead of hardcoded 16. Build npm run production passed, but FR-03 remains HOLD because lint-fk-bundle-legacy scans public/build while Mix emits public/js, and direct public/js scan shows active pos-wizard/legacy cutover references. FR-04/05/06/07/08/10/11/12/13 remain HOLD for release evidence: staging rehearsal, branch leak evidence, target runtime preflight, hardware signatures, full runtime E2E, fiscal real evidence, UAT, runbook drills, and human final GO gate. Reports: reports/release/CAISSE_V1_FINAL_READINESS_WAVES_2026-04-26.md, reports/release/CAISSE_V1_RELEASE_DECISION_PACKET_2026-04-26.md, reports/audit/GPT_AUDIT_CAISSE_V1_FINAL_READINESS_WAVES_2026-04-26.md.
source_description: FoodKing Caisse V1 final readiness waves

name: caisse_v1_fr03_bundle_guard_rework
episode_body: FR-03 bundle guard coverage was reworked on 2026-04-26. scripts/scan-bundle-legacy.sh and scripts/lint-fk-bundle-legacy.sh now scan both public/build and public/js. .github/workflows/legacy-guards.yml now triggers on public/js. Archive legacy references remain blocking. pos-wizard references outside public/js/pos-wizard.js warn by default and fail strict release mode with FK_LEGACY_STRICT_POS_WIZARD=1. Strict mode currently fails on public/js/kiosk.js and public/js/kiosk-wizard.js, so release remains HOLD until HG-W2 cutover or explicit human shim acceptance with test evidence.
source_description: FoodKing Caisse V1 FR-03 bundle guard rework
